description: Record a traveller REQUEST to book and send it to the Sparkling Tracks team. This does NOT book, hold or charge anything, and no confirmation exists until a human replies: none of the operators we work with can be booked programmatically. Call it only after check_availability has returned a specific trip and departure date that the traveller has chosen, and only once they have given a name and email. The request is checked against the stored departure list and is rejected if the departure has already left, is closed or does not exist. The team then confirms it with the operator. Returns a reference the traveller can quote. NEVER ask for or pass a passport number, a full date of birth, or any card or bank detail; those are collected securely by a human later. Tell the traveller plainly that nothing is held or charged yet.

ages.description: Coarse age bands only, for trips with an age policy, for example "2 adults, 1 child 9". Never a full date of birth.

departure_city.description: Where the traveller would fly from, for a flight quote.

departure_date.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD, must be one of that trip's departures.

nationality.description: Drives visa requirement. Not an identity document.

needs_flights.description: Whether they want flights quoted alongside the trip.

notes.description: Anything else the traveller wants us to know.

occupancy.description: Twin, Single, Triple, Twin Share, or cabin class for a cruise.

rooms.description: Room split, for example "1 twin + 1 single".

title.description: Trip title, only when no tripId is available. One of trip_id and title must be given.

trip_id.description: The tripId returned by check_availability. PREFER THIS: it names exactly one trip. A title can name several, and the request is refused rather than guessing which. The trip number (1024). The same digits as text, the start of its page address (1024-from-london-to-budapest) and a link to its page are read as well.

name: request_to_book
